Sell.Intro: List what you sell under your own name. Your username and your photo go on every listing, and buyers deal with you directly. Confirming your email is all it takes.
Sell.ShopsBody: A shop is optional. It gives what you sell its own name, logo and storefront, and your listings are sold under it instead of under your username. Shops are requested, and Plaza reviews each one before it opens.

Editor.Description.PlaceholderProperty: Describe what it is like inside, what is nearby, and why somebody would want to live there.
Editor.Operation.Label: For sale or to rent?
Editor.Operation.Required: Choose whether it is for sale or to rent.
Editor.Operation.Hint: One listing is one or the other. If you offer both, publish it twice.
Editor.PropertyCondition.Label: Condition
Editor.PropertyCondition.Required: Say what condition it is in.
Editor.Price.RentHint: What is paid each month, not counting the service charge.
Editor.Area.PrivateHint: What is lived in, without walls or communal space. It cannot exceed the built area.
Editor.Area.LotHint: Only for a house, a farm or a plot.
Editor.Stratum.Label: Stratum
Editor.Stratum.Hint: It sets the utility bills, and is one of the first things a buyer looks at.

Editor.Address.Hint: Always stored in full. Below you choose how much of it a stranger sees.
Editor.Address.Visibility: How much of the address is shown?
Editor.Address.VisibilityHint: Whoever you accept for a visit always sees the full address, whatever you choose.

Editor.Phone.PublicHint: Left unticked, your phone is only shared when you accept a visit.
Editor.Phone.PublicWarning: Unticking it later removes it from the listing, but whoever saw it already has it.
Editor.Phone.Missing: Add a phone to your account to be able to show it.

Members.Title: Who works here
Members.Intro: A collaborator publishes, edits and archives the whole shop catalogue, answers questions and visits, and handles sales. Deleting a listing stays with whoever created it, or with you.
Members.IntroMember: You work in this shop. You can list under its name, edit any listing and deal with its buyers.
Members.Invite.Label: Invite somebody
Members.Invite.Hint: They get an invitation. They do not join until they accept it.
Members.RemoveConfirm.Title: Remove {{name}}?
Members.RemoveConfirm.Body: They stop seeing the shop's catalogue, sales and questions. What they listed stays: it belongs to the shop, not to the person.
Members.RemoveConfirm.Label: Remove from the shop
Members.LeaveConfirm.Title: Leave {{shop}}?
Members.LeaveConfirm.Body: You stop seeing its catalogue and its sales. What you listed stays with the shop. Only the owner can invite you back.
Members.LeaveConfirm.Label: Leave
Invitations.Title: Invitations
Invitations.Heading: You were invited to work in a shop
Invitations.Body: If you accept, you can list under its name, edit its catalogue and deal with its buyers. Nothing happens until you answer.
